statement: Delay in fiber Link/Route provisioning prevents remaining sites from reaching RFO
mitigation: Weekly coordination with HLC committee; agree dated route plan per site; escalate >180d cases

statement: Delay in GECOL power connection prevents remaining sites from reaching RFO
mitigation: Track PR-to-meter lead time; escalate pending meters weekly

statement: Ageing of long-open sites threatens overall project closeout
mitigation: Assign a recovery batch; weekly aging review

statement: Absence of a forward-dated schedule baseline prevents early warning and reliable forecasting
mitigation: Freeze planned PAC / Adaption Finish dates for all open sites; lock baseline before next reporting cycle

statement: Delay in PAC postpones warranty start and final closeout
mitigation: Clear outstanding snags; schedule joint inspection

statement: Site access obstruction prevents start or complete CW
mitigation: Early landlord/Tower owner engagement; keep access/lease tracker; escalate blocked access to project management

statement: Landlord / Tower owner dispute or lease issue leads to site relocation and rework
mitigation: Verify lease validity and renewal dates before MOS; keep candidate alternates per site

statement: Security issue suspends blocks MOS or suspends ongoing field work
mitigation: Monitor target area and update security status; keep flexible sequencing to shift team to safe place

statement: Bad weather (Rain / Heat) delays work
mitigation: Plan outdoor work outside peak rain/heat window; finish indoor activities

statement: Long-lead material shortage delays work
mitigation: Track PO-to-MOS lead time; pre-order during survey; confirm stock with contractor before MOS

statement: Quality snags cause rework
mitigation: Enforce pre-acceptance selfcheck by contractor; track First-Pass Yield; penalize repeat snags

statement: Contractor incapacity or slow performance delays delivery
mitigation: Monitor contractor performance and check scorecard; require recovery plan; re-allocate work from low performers

statement: Design / scope change after layout approval causes delay or rework
mitigation: Freeze layout after approval; route any change back through formal channel

statement: EHS incident creates liability exposure
mitigation: Enforce contractor HSE plan, PPE and method statements; record and review incidents

statement: Incomplete or inaccurate data weaken reporting reliability
mitigation: Run dashboard Data Quality checks each cycle; correct flagged rows before reporting

statement: Site onair but not contractually closed, TE PAC lags onair by a wide margin
mitigation: Collect pre-acceptance reviews; set weekly PAC session; escalate site older than 30 days

statement: Site cannot go onair because uplink site not ready
mitigation: Resequence the work so FN then HUB sites go live first; track the dependency chain per cluster

statement: PAT sign-off backlog holds sites short of Pre-Acceptance and blocks PAC
mitigation: Enforce 10 working days observation window then sign; clear PAT queue in batches

statement: Equipment installation quality is not measurable, HW Installation Doc snag column is empty, so vendor first-pass yield cannot be tracked
mitigation: Make snag field filling in at Doc Sign-off mandatory; report vendor FPY (quality snag) periodically

statement: TE installation lead time breaches agreed plan by a wide margin
mitigation: Review the plan with the vendor; identify delay driver per segment and rebaseline

statement: MW link RSL target not reached, leading to re-alignment visit and delay onair
mitigation: Verify RSL against design at MW alignment; do not sign HW Installation Doc before  target is met

statement: Power capacity is undersized for installed load, risking outages after handover
mitigation: Validate rated rectifier and battery capacity against site load before EIR; record backup time

statement: Equipment records are incomplete, weakening O&M handover and spares planning
mitigation: Complete equipment database at As-Built; make it a checklist item for O&M handover

statement: Dismantle scope (If Any) is undefined, so site dismantle obligations are unplanned
mitigation: Confirm scope & which sites need dismantle; accordingly set dismantle plan & return process before any mobilisation

statement: Access permission date for TE installation is not recorded, so TE entry gate cannot be tracked or escalated
mitigation: Record the TE installation access permission date per site; treat it as the first TE gate
